Lemma
[curvature-gradient estimate under three-dimensional pinching] Source: cao-zhu 1. Claim 1\group Differentiable Sphere Theorems For any $\varepsilon >0$, there exists a positive constant $C_\varepsilon <+\infty $ such that for any time $\tau \ge 0$, we have \[ \max _{t\le \tau }\max _{x\in M}|\nabla Rm(x,t)| \le \varepsilon \max _{t\le \tau }\max _{x\in M}|Rm(x,t)|^\frac {3}{2}+C_\varepsilon . \]
